first_step_test: One arched back connected to a rounded triangular head establishes the pose, with the whole underside left open for connected legs and belly.

source.notes: Six additive felt-tip panels for one right-facing chameleon. Two near-side legs shown; far-side legs fully hidden. No temporary guides. First sheet rejected for erased belly sections at leg additions and covered branch edge when leaf arrives. Repair reserves two leg openings in step 1 and introduces branch plus leaf together in step 3. No branch grain before final. Second sheet rejected because short belly gaps do not fully reserve the later leg widths; third edit removes the whole early underside, allowing legs and belly to be drawn together. Third edit passes early-panel review but its final drops the front stripe. Isolated final recoloring requested from the authoritative step-5 line drawing; all prior masters retained. Final repaired from saved step-5 line art, saved as finished-v2.jpg; complete assembled review sheet is drafts/cartoon-chameleon-on-a-branch/approved-assembled-contact-sheet.jpg. Early frames from third six-panel sheet; generated final source retained separately.

frames.step_name: Curve three stripes across the body

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first JPG has one broad back arch and attached triangular head, with the entire underside empty. The short left return becomes the inner tail connection. This sparse connected contour is easy to copy without guessing where future legs will overlap.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: The six saved images progress from open back/head, attached spiral tail, connected legs/belly/branch/leaf, face, three stripe regions, then color. Every adjacent pair was inspected, including a repaired finished-v2 image made from step-5 line art. The branch starts at the inner tail boundary and stops behind both foot grips; no taught line is erased. No temporary guides are used.

transitions.observed_addition: The outer tail joins the upper-left back curve and sweeps down into a thick open spiral; its inner edge returns to the existing short left-side endpoint. The arched back and closed triangular head keep their shapes, and the whole belly remains open.
transitions.instruction_match: The copy asks for a broad tapering spiral with the inner edge meeting the short body curve. It leaves the underside open for the next step; no early belly mark needs removal.

transitions.observed_addition: A short rear belly curve extends from the tail return into the bent rear leg. The middle belly connects to the front leg, whose outer side meets the lower head seam. Each foot has one short crease. Two branch edges begin at the inner tail boundary and pass behind the feet, ending at one pointed right leaf with a central vein. The open spiral and head contours persist.
transitions.instruction_match: The leg instruction builds all previously absent underside curves in one connected step, draws feet before the branch, and adds branch and leaf together. Neither tail nor feet require hidden erasures.

transitions.observed_addition: One large round eye appears high inside the head with its dark pupil against the right side, and a long curved smile sits below. The tail coil remains open, the two foot creases stay separate, the branch stops behind both grips, and the pointed leaf and center vein remain at the right end.
transitions.instruction_match: The face step names the oversized turret eye, right-looking pupil and long smile. It does not introduce unmentioned nostrils or eyebrow marks.

transitions.observed_addition: Three curved tapering stripe outlines descend from the back: rear stripe above the rear leg, middle stripe over the belly, and front stripe against the head seam. The front stripe shares its upper start with the adjacent middle stripe but has its own pointed lower end. Both legs, both toe creases, two belly connections, branch, leaf vein, eye, pupil, smile and entire tail coil remain.
transitions.instruction_match: The stripe step describes back-to-point-and-back strokes within the body, stopping above the leg attachments. All three separate enclosed areas are visible; the head, legs and tail remain unpatterned.

transitions.observed_addition: Lime fills the established head, body, tail and both legs. Rear, middle AND front stripe regions are now turquoise; the repaired front stripe retains both black boundaries and its low point beside the head seam. The turret eye is yellow, pupil remains right-looking, smile keeps its arc, both toe creases and belly joins remain, the branch is brown, and the single leaf is teal with its central black vein. Tail tip and open spiral space retain their positions.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction colors the three existing stripe regions and the established eye, body, branch and leaf. Heavier black edges clarify existing contours; no new structure is introduced. The previously missing front stripe is present and countable.
